summary: Recursion is the AI drug discovery bet — building the largest biological dataset on earth, partnered with Sanofi ($150M+) and Roche to discover drugs at machine speed. With 5 clinical programs advancing and cash into 2028, the bear case (no approvals, burn) is already priced in at $3.18. The moon case: one Phase 3 approval or Big Pharma acquisition = 5–10x. Binary risk: clinical trials can fail. Position max 2–3% — ถ้า trial fail = ลงได้ 50–70%.
